question:
Steroid hormones affect expression of primary response genes and secondary response genes in cells as schematically shown in the figure below.

Primary and secondary response genes can be distinguished by ...
question_zh:
类固醇激素影响细胞中初级反应基因与次级反应基因的表达，如下图所示。

可以通过以下处理区分初级反应基因与次级反应基因……

images.caption: Schematic representation of primary and secondary response genes. One primary-response protein shuts off primary-response genes; another primary-response protein turns on secondary-response genes.
images.caption_zh: 初级反应基因与次级反应基因示意图。一种初级反应蛋白关闭初级反应基因；另一种初级反应蛋白开启次级反应基因。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: inhibition of DNA replication simultaneously with hormone administration
subQuestions.text_zh: 在给予激素的同时抑制 DNA 复制

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: inhibition of transcription simultaneously with hormone administration
subQuestions.text_zh: 在给予激素的同时抑制转录

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: inhibition of translation simultaneously with hormone administration
subQuestions.text_zh: 在给予激素的同时抑制翻译

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: inhibition of transcription and translation simultaneously with hormone administration
subQuestions.text_zh: 在给予激素的同时同时抑制转录和翻译

explanation:
A【错】抑制 DNA 复制并不阻断激素—受体复合物对初级反应基因的直接转录激活，也不能把两级反应分开。
B【错】同时抑制转录会把初级反应和次级反应一起阻断，无法区分两者。
C【对】初级反应由激素—受体复合物直接激活转录，不需要先合成新蛋白；次级反应依赖初级反应蛋白的合成。因此加入翻译抑制剂后，初级反应仍能发生，而次级反应被阻断，从而区分两级反应。
D【错】同时抑制转录和翻译会把两级反应都阻断，得不到区分信息。
